leaves.acfr_source: raw/pensions_debt/funds/PABF_FS_2025.txt lines 730 to 732 (2025 statement of changes)
leaves.pieces_note: The remainder toward the unfunded liability is still >= $10M as dollars. It is the debt the City is paying down, set by law, so the explorer shows it as 'paying for past promises' across the retirees below (count x average).
leaves.why_cant_go_deeper: The City sends one payment set by law to the retirement fund, and the fund then pays thousands of retirees, so the public records stop at how many retirees there are and what the average one gets.

leaves.split_basis: One voluntary payment above the statutory minimum, sent to the same fund. Shown with the same retiree count x average as the statutory line.
